blocks.text: Full House Theater Company (FHTC) has announced the principal cast of “& Juliet,” the Tony Award-nominated musical set to make its Manila debut in September 2027 as the first homegrown Asian production of the show and the inaugural theater production at Westside Resort in Parañaque City.
